name: B10-0395/2025 (ECR) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Rwanda. It says the charges against opposition leader Victoire Ingabire are politically motivated and that her trial should meet international standards. If it does not, the Parliament demands her release and the return of her civil and political rights. It also calls on Rwanda to respect its human rights obligations and to allow a working opposition, free civil society and independent media.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its opinion on Rwanda.
- It concerns Victoire Ingabire, her party's activists and Rwandan critics of the government.
- Parliament sends its position to Rwanda's president, the European Union bodies, the African Union and the United Nations.
